create_DemoLoader: create a DemoLoader dataset from a scene directory with images and optional masks
build_DemoLoader_get_data: build a batch of transformed images and camera parameters from a DemoLoader sequence
run_calculate_crop_parameters: run crop parameter calculation for an image given a bounding box and target size
run_pad_and_resize_image: run image padding and resizing with optional mask and bounding box annotation
run__crop_image: run image cropping to a bounding box with optional white background padding
